_comment: Copy to config/extractor.json to enable. Default (no file) = marker.
_marker: Human-authored ::atom blocks only. Deterministic, zero deps.
_llm_cli: Switch extractor to 'llm' + backend 'cli' to shell out to any model CLI.
_llm_http: Or backend 'http-local' to POST a local model server (ollama/LM Studio/llama.cpp).
